QF.id: Duplicate Share Certificates and Transmission of Securities_15

question.text: Suresh holds shares jointly with his wife Priya. Suresh passes away. What is the first step for Priya to get the securities transmitted in her name?

answer.text: Obtain a succession certificate from the court
File an FIR for the share certificates
Apply for deletion of Suresh's name with death certificate, original certificates, and self-attested PAN
Execute a new instrument of transfer (Form SH-4) in her name

explanation.text: The Logic: On the death of a joint holder, the surviving holder(s) apply for deletion/transmission. The documents listed by the workbook are the original share certificates, certified death certificate of the deceased holder and self-attested PAN of the surviving holders. The Trap: Candidates may treat the joint-holding case the same as a single-holder transmission and ask for a succession certificate or a fresh transfer form. Neither is listed by the workbook for this deletion process. Note: The deletion/transmission process for joint holdings on death of a joint holder, and the specific documents required, are covered on page 156 of the NISM-Series-II-A Registrars and Transfer Agents (Corporate) Certification Examination workbook (October 2025).
